description: Drupal core module JavaScript file defining behaviors for block settings summaries and block dragging in the admin interface.

methods.name: checkboxesSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary string for checked checkboxes within a given context.

methods.name: checkEmptyRegions
methods.description: Checks and updates the visual state of regions based on whether they are empty or populated.

methods.name: updateLastPlaced
methods.description: Updates the visual indication of the last placed block in the table.

methods.name: updateBlockWeights
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the weights of blocks within a specified region.
